📚 1. 15 Từ Vựng Cốt Lõi (Kèm Phát Âm Audio Bản Xứ)

Bấm vào nút 🔊 để nghe phát âm chuẩn bản xứ của từng từ vựng (trên iPhone, hãy gạt cần rung sang chế độ Chuông để bật loa ngoài). Hệ thống tối ưu hiển thị linh hoạt trên cả điện thoại, máy tính bảng và máy tính:

⚠️ BẠN ĐANG MỞ Ở CHẾ ĐỘ XEM TRƯỚC — ÂM THANH SẼ KHÔNG CHẠY
Ứng dụng Tệp (Files) và Zalo trên iPhone chặn JavaScript, nên nút 🔊, chấm điểm và micro đều bị vô hiệu.
👉 Hãy mở bài học bằng đường link https:// mà giáo viên gửi (bấm vào link trong Zalo ➔ chọn biểu tượng la bàn Safari).
Bấm để máy tự động đọc lần lượt từng từ và hiển thị theo dõi (phù hợp học trên điện thoại)
1. retail (n/adj)
/ˈriːteɪl/
bán lẻ (bán hàng hóa trực tiếp cho người tiêu dùng cuối cùng)
Collocation: online retail, retail sector, brick-and-mortar retail store
"The bar chart compares online retail sales with traditional brick-and-mortar store sales."
2. transaction (n)
/trænˈzækʃn/
giao dịch mua bán, thanh toán tài chính
Collocation: digital transaction, secure online transaction
"Modern encryption technology ensures that every digital transaction is safe from hackers."
3. delivery (n)
/dɪˈlɪvəri/
dịch vụ giao hàng tận nơi
Collocation: same-day delivery, home delivery service, express delivery
"Free home delivery is one of the main reasons why people prefer shopping on e-commerce platforms."
4. convenience (n)
/kənˈviːniəns/
sự tiện lợi, thuận tiện
Collocation: for convenience, the convenience of online shopping
"Busy office workers value the convenience of ordering groceries on their smartphones."
5. storefront (n)
/ˈstɔːfrʌnt/
cửa hàng vật lý có mặt tiền (còn gọi là brick-and-mortar store)
Collocation: physical storefront, local storefront
"Many small physical storefronts have closed because they cannot compete with giant websites."
6. competitor (n)
/kəmˈpetɪtə(r)/
đối thủ cạnh tranh trên thị trường
Collocation: main competitor, outperform a competitor
"To attract customers away from competitors, the supermarket lowered its delivery fees."
7. revenue (n)
/ˈrevənjuː/
tổng doanh thu của doanh nghiệp hoặc ngành hàng
Collocation: annual revenue, generate revenue
"E-commerce generated over sixty percent of the company's total annual revenue in 2025."
8. outnumber (v)
/ˌaʊtˈnʌmbə(r)/
đông hơn, vượt trội hơn về mặt số lượng (Task 1 Bar Chart)
Collocation: outnumber by two to one, significantly outnumber
"Among people aged 18 to 25, online shoppers outnumbered in-store shoppers by three to one."
9. surpass (v)
/səˈpɑːs/
vượt qua, lớn hơn một mức số liệu hoặc đối thủ (= exceed / overtake)
Collocation: surpass expectations, surpass traditional retail
"In 2023, mobile shopping sales surpassed desktop computer sales for the first time."
10. account (v)
/əˈkaʊnt/
chiếm tỷ lệ bao nhiêu phần trăm (luôn đi với giới từ FOR: account for + %)
Collocation: account for the largest share, account for 45% of
"Clothing and electronics accounted for 38% and 29% of total online purchases respectively."
11. respectively (adv)
/rɪˈspektɪvli/
lần lượt tương ứng với thứ tự đã nêu trước đó (Từ vàng Task 1)
Collocation: at 45% and 30% respectively
"Online sales in the UK and France stood at 65% and 52% respectively."
12. dominate (v)
/ˈdɒmɪneɪt/
chiếm ưu thế áp đảo, thống lĩnh thị trường/biểu đồ
Collocation: dominate the market, dominate the chart
"Two international corporations currently dominate the global e-commerce market."
13. demographic (n/adj)
/ˌdeməˈɡræfɪk/
nhóm nhân khẩu học (nhóm dân cư phân theo độ tuổi, thu nhập...)
Collocation: younger demographic, age demographic
"The 18-to-34 age demographic spends the highest proportion of money on digital entertainment."
14. preference (n)
/ˈprefrəns/
sự ưa chuộng, sở thích ưu tiên hơn (have/show a preference for)
Collocation: consumer preference, strong preference for
"Older citizens still show a strong preference for inspecting fresh food in person."
15. warranty (n)
/ˈwɒrənti/
giấy bảo hành, chế độ bảo hành sản phẩm
Collocation: two-year warranty, under warranty
"When buying expensive laptops, customers want an official two-year warranty."

⚙️ 2. Bài Giảng Ngữ Pháp 2 Tầng (Grammar Masterclass)

🟢 Tầng 1: Cấu Trúc So Sánh Tỷ Lệ & Đối Chiếu Nhóm Trong Biểu Đồ Cột (Task 1 Bar Chart)

• Động từ báo cáo tỷ trọng chuẩn Cambridge: account for / represent / make up + [Số %] + of + [Tổng thể]
  Ví dụ: E-commerce transactions accounted for 68% of total retail purchases among young adults.

• So sánh gấp bội (Multiple Comparisons): twice / three times + as + Adj (high/large/popular) + as
  Ví dụ: Online shopping in the 18–29 age demographic was twice as popular as in the over-60 group (70% compared to 35%).

🔵 Tầng 2: Kỹ Thuật Gộp Số Liệu Bằng 'Respectively' & Phân Từ Hiện Tại 'Accounting for'

• Cách dùng respectively (Lần lượt tương ứng — Giúp gộp 2 câu đơn thành 1 câu Band 7.5+):
  Ví dụ: The proportions of consumers buying books and clothes online stood at 64% and 52% respectively.

• Mệnh đề phân từ rút gọn , accounting for [Số %]: Đặt ở cuối câu để báo cáo số liệu mượt mà.
  Ví dụ: Smartphones dominated digital retail transactions in 2025, accounting for 72% of all online orders.

🎯 20 Câu Test Từ Vựng (Vocabulary Mastery Test)

1. The bar chart illustrates changes in the ________ sector, comparing online websites with high-street shops.
2. Every credit card ________ on our website is protected by two-factor authentication.
3. Many customers are willing to pay an extra fee for same-day home ________.
4. Despite higher shipping fees, working parents love the ________ of ordering household goods from home.
5. Rising city centre rent has forced many independent bookshops to close their physical ________.
6. By offering lower prices and faster shipping, the new company quickly overtook its main ________.
7. During the November shopping festival, the company generated record ________ of $400 million.
8. In the 20-to-30 age group, mobile app users ________ desktop shoppers by more than three to one.
9. Analysts predict that digital retail sales will ________ physical store sales in the next five years.
10. In 2025, electronics and fashion ________ for 42% and 35% of total e-commerce revenue.
11. Online grocery sales in Japan and South Korea reached 58% and 71% ________.
12. Large supermarket chains ________ food retail in urban areas, leaving little room for small grocers.
13. The over-65 age ________ still prefers speaking to a helpful shop assistant face to face.
14. Surveys show a clear consumer ________ for eco-friendly packaging and recyclable delivery boxes.
15. This washing machine comes with a three-year manufacturer's ________ that covers all repair costs.
16. [Ôn tập Unit 13] Flash sales on e-commerce apps often tempt shoppers to buy clothes on ________.
17. [Ôn tập Unit 13] Honest customer service and fast delivery help online stores build strong brand ________.
18. [Ôn tập Unit 12] Between 2015 and 2025, the ________ of people shopping on smartphones surged.
19. [Ôn tập Unit 11] Delivery drivers face a very heavy ________ during the year-end holiday season.
20. [Ôn tập Unit 5] Strong ________ measures are essential to protect customers' credit card data online.
Điểm: 0/20

⚙️ 10 Câu Test Ngữ Pháp Ứng Dụng (Grammar Mastery Test)

1. In 2025, online retail transactions accounted ________ 65% of total book sales.
2. E-commerce preferences in the 18–29 and 30–49 age groups stood at 75% and 60% ________.
3. Among teenagers, ordering clothes online was twice as ________ as shopping in physical storefronts.
4. Smartphones dominated digital shopping in 2025, ________ for 70% of all retail transactions.
5. ________ younger demographics strongly prefer e-commerce convenience, older shoppers still favor physical stores.
6. In the over-60 demographic, in-store buyers outnumbered online buyers ________ three to one (75% vs 25%).
7. Fashion was the most popular online category for young women, ________ electronics ranked first among men.
8. The proportion of revenue generated by physical storefronts was significantly ________ than that of online apps.
9. Customers show a strong preference ________ retailers that offer free returns and a two-year warranty.
10. If local storefronts ________ free home delivery, they could compete more effectively with giant websites.

👨 Customer Service Agent: Good morning, TechMart Online Customer Support. My name is David. How may I help you today?
👩 Customer: Hello! I ordered a laptop from your e-commerce website three days ago, and I have a question about the delivery.
👨 Customer Service Agent: Certainly. Could you give me your surname and order reference? Is your surname spelled Reynolds?
👩 Customer: No, it is Whitaker. That is spelled W - H - I - T - A - K - E - R. 💡 Đáp án câu 1 (Đánh vần họ): WHITAKER
👨 Customer Service Agent: Thank you, Ms. Whitaker. And what is the transaction reference number on your email receipt?
👩 Customer: The transaction code is TM - 4829. 💡 Đáp án câu 2 (Mã giao dịch): TM-4829 / 4829
👨 Customer Service Agent: I have found your record. You ordered the UltraBook Pro 15. What seems to be the issue?
👩 Customer: I selected express home delivery, but the tracking page says the parcel is still at the warehouse.
👨 Customer Service Agent: I sincerely apologize for the delay. Due to high demand during our summer sale, courier deliveries are one day behind schedule.
👩 Customer: I see. I need the laptop for a business presentation on Friday. Can I collect it from your physical storefront instead?
👨 Customer Service Agent: Yes, of course! I can transfer your order to our central storefront on King Street for collection this afternoon. 💡 Đáp án câu 3 (Tên phố cửa hàng): King Street
👩 Customer: That is much more convenient! Will you refund the express delivery fee that I paid?
👨 Customer Service Agent: Absolutely. I will process an immediate refund of £15 back to your credit card. 💡 Đáp án câu 4 (Số tiền hoàn trả): 15
👩 Customer: Thank you! One last question: does the laptop include a standard one-year warranty?
👨 Customer Service Agent: Because you ordered during our promotion, we have upgraded your warranty to three years free of charge! 💡 Bẫy 1 năm vs 3 năm câu 5 & 6: 3 / three years

📰 IELTS Academic Reading: Passage & Questions

[Paragraph A - Generational Differences in Shopping Preferences]
A recent survey of the national retail sector reveals striking differences in shopping preferences across three age demographics. Among young adults aged 18 to 29, online shopping platforms clearly dominate, accounting for 75% of all clothing and electronics purchases. In this younger group, digital buyers outnumber traditional in-store shoppers by three to one, largely due to the convenience of 24-hour browsing and rapid home delivery.

[Paragraph B - Middle-Aged and Senior Consumers]
In the 30-to-49 age bracket, online orders still surpass physical store visits, standing at 58% and 42% respectively. Conversely, consumers aged 60 and over show a strong preference for visiting a local brick-and-mortar storefront, which represents 68% of their total retail spending. Senior citizens value speaking directly to staff about product warranties and remain cautious about the security of digital transactions.

[Paragraph C - How Brick-and-Mortar Stores Compete]
Although e-commerce continues to generate massive annual revenue, physical shops are not disappearing. To stay ahead of online competitors, successful retailers now combine both channels into an 'omnichannel' model. Shoppers can inspect furniture or try on shoes at a city showroom and then arrange convenient home delivery through the store's mobile app.
Điểm: 0/6

✍️ Academic Writing Lab (CHUYÊN ĐỀ IELTS TASK 1: BAR CHART — So Sánh Tỷ Lệ Mua Sắm Online vs. Cửa Hàng Truyền Thống Theo 3 Nhóm Tuổi)

Đề bài: The bar chart data below compares the proportion of retail purchases made Online versus at Physical Storefronts across three age demographics in 2025: • Aged 18–29: Online Retail = 75% | Physical Storefronts = 25% • Aged 30–49: Online Retail = 58% | Physical Storefronts = 42% • Aged 60+: Online Retail = 32% | Physical Storefronts = 68% Write an Academic Task 1 summary report (75 - 95 words) highlighting the main overview and comparing the figures across the age groups.

Tiêu chuẩn: Có câu Overview (Overall,...), sử dụng trạng từ 'respectively', động từ 'account for / surpass / outnumber / dominate' và tối thiểu 5 từ vựng Unit 14 (retail, storefront, demographic, preference, convenience, delivery...).
